seed_data_creation: Hindi names (name_hi field) were populated for all 47 products using /app/backend/populate_hindi_names.py script
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hindi product name translation feature is fully working. The getProductName() helper function in Dashboard.js and other admin pages correctly displays Hindi names when language is 'hi'. Products have name_hi field populated in the database. Language can be switched using the language selector dropdown in the top-right corner of the app.

hindi_product_names.implementation: getProductName() helper function in each page
hindi_product_names.logic: Checks i18n.language === 'hi', then returns product.name_hi if available
hindi_product_names.fallback: Returns English name if Hindi name not available
